question: Where in the 2025 Public Accounts can I find Canada’s audited consolidated financial statements?
generated_answer:
You can find Canada’s audited consolidated financial statements in Part I of the 2025 Public Accounts, specifically in Chapter 1 (Consolidated Financial Statements) and Chapter 2 (Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements). These sections provide a detailed overview of the government’s financial position, performance, and cash flows.

To access the 2025 Public Accounts, you can visit the following link: [https://www.publicaccounts.gc.ca/2025-public-accounts/part-i/consolidated-financial-statements/consolidated-financial-statements-2025](https://www.publicaccounts.gc.ca/2025-public-accounts/part-i/consolidated-financial-statements/consolidated-financial-statements-2025)

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to ask!
